item.title: 🇮🇩 🚨 BANK NEGARA INDONESIA (BNI) CUSTOMER DB & MOBILE BANKING ACCESS ALLEGEDLY OFFERED FOR SALE A threat actor on an underground forum claims...
item.description:
🇮🇩 🚨 BANK NEGARA INDONESIA (BNI) CUSTOMER DB & MOBILE BANKING ACCESS ALLEGEDLY OFFERED FOR SALE

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to be selling live backend access and customer data associated with Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI), Indonesia's large state-owned commercial bank.

The actor claims the offering includes:
* Complete customer database / mass PII exposure (CIF, names, emails, phones alleged)
* Unauthenticated mobile-banking backend / SOAP web-service access
* Hundreds of exposed web methods (account, card, beneficiary, credential-change style operations alleged)
* "Live production" access rather than a historical dump (seller claim)

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Live banking-access claims are frequently exaggerated. Screenshots and method lists do not prove production reachability, and "complete customer database" language is a common sales flourish. Still, any plausible unauthenticated banking API claim warrants defender attention at BNI and Indonesian financial regulators.

We assess this as an unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation that BNI production systems are currently compromised.

If authentic, impact could include account takeover, fraud, and large-scale customer PII abuse.

item.description:
STORY | Iyer moves up three places to career-high 4th in ICC T20I rankings

India captain Shreyas Iyer jumped three places to a career-high fourth spot in the ICC's latest T20 International rankings for batters after making a blistering start in the ongoing five-match home series against the West Indies.

Iyer smashed his maiden T20I century during the series-opener in Lucknow and his rise to fourth means India have four players inside the top quartet of the rankings for T20I batters.

Iyer joined Ishan Kishan (top spot) and Abhishek Sharma (second) in the top-four with Sahibzada Farhan sandwiching the trio in third place. The Pakistan skipper reached a career-best rating following an impressive display against Sri Lanka, the ICC said in a press release.

Other players to make gains among T20I batters were Kusal Mendis (up three places to 23rd), Sherfane Rutherford (up 13 slots to joint 24th) and Sanju Samson (up four rungs to joint 27th).

item.description:
VIDEO | Bihar: State Health Minister Nishant Kumar visits the Nalanda Medical College and Hospital (NMCH) to meet the families of the victims affected by the boat accident in Raghopur area of Vaishali district.

He said, "A boat capsized in the middle of the river in Raghopur Diara, Vaishali district and around 13 people lost their lives. I pray for the peace of the departed souls and extend my deepest condolences and heartfelt sympathies. May God give the bereaved families the strength to bear this immense grief. Ever since the news broke yesterday, the district administration and the Civil Surgeon have been actively working on the ground. Despite their efforts, 13 people died, six of whom were brought here to NMCH by ambulance. I have spoken with the District Magistrate (DM) and ordered an investigation into why this incident occurred, so that such tragedies can be prevented in the future."

"Two children are admitted to the PICU here; they are doing well and are out of danger. Another child is in the pediatric ward and is also stable. The Health Department is working continuously, and the DM informed me that an ex-gratia compensation of Rs 4 lakh has been sanctioned to the families of each deceased individual. We are awaiting the investigation report to determine the exact cause of the accident..." he added.

(Full video available on PTI Videos - http://ptivideos.com)

item.description:
STORY | 40 more talukas added to drought-hit list in Maharashtra; total rises to 305

The Maharashtra government has added 40 more talukas to the drought-hit list, taking the total affected talukas to 305 out of the state's 358, Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis said on Wednesday.

Farmers in these talukas can avail the government assistance extended to drought-hit areas, Fadnavis told reporters after the cabinet meeting.

Last month, the state government declared drought in 265 talukas following rainfall deficit and announced relief measures, including crop loan restructuring, land revenue concessions, and power bill subsidies.

Fadnavis said the cabinet also passed a resolution congratulating Prime Minister Narendra Modi for completing 25 years as head of government.

Modi has been serving continuously as head of government — first as chief minister of Gujarat for three terms and subsequently as prime minister of India after winning three Lok Sabha elections since October 7, 2001.

VIDEO | Delhi: Congress MP Rahul Gandhi addresses a press conference with protesters, introduces a female protester as "our sherni". He says, "I want to introduce our 'sherni'. She was beaten, but she was not afraid. There was no hatred in her heart."

The female protester alleges that she was assaulted by a woman police constable during a protest. She says, "Yesterday, all NSUI workers were protesting peacefully when we were detained in three buses. There were many of our colleagues, around 30-40 in each bus. In our bus, there were two girls and 20-30 other NSUI colleagues. There was a woman constable in the bus named Chanchal Yadav. After being detained, we tried to get off the bus again through the gate and continue leading the protest. We tried to stop the bus and sat down beneath it so that our protest could somehow continue. But Chanchal Yadav grabbed me tightly by the neck and pushed me, causing me to fall backwards onto the seat. She then scratched my face with her nails, leaving scratches across my face and near my ear. When I resisted her, she slapped me so hard and said, 'Here, take another slap across your face.'"
